APPROVE
The extraction moves the three loops verbatim into helpers, so behaviour is unchanged and `InScript` drops to about 2. I couldn't open the source or run a build here (my shell commands returned no output), so the one unverified risk is that the helper parameter types (`Func<Family, bool>`, `IReadOnlyDictionary<string, bool>`, `IReadOnlySet<string>`) must match the actual locals.
